site.name: Petr Šajgal
bio: Petr Šajgal is a Czech photographer specialising in fashion. He works with local designers and model agencies across Czechia, with a focus on editorials, backstage photography and catwalk videos.

His work spans runway coverage and behind-the-scenes documentation of shows including Mercedes-Benz Prague Fashion Week, Berlin Fashion Week, and designer shows such as Jan Société and Martin Kohout. He regularly collaborates with ELLE Czech, most recently covering MBPFW FW26 for the magazine. His work has also appeared in Vogue CS and Harper's Bazaar.
